title: Fidelity Collapses with Table Size, Not Turn Count: Delivery Architecture in a Deployed Tool-Using Agent
abstract: arXiv:2611.00442v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a multi-turn agent delivers a tool's structured records into the model's context and re-emits them each turn, every turn can corrupt data the tool computed correctly. We measure this in a production award-travel agent: two architectures over identical frozen payloads, lineage-matched prompts and sampling, differing only in delivery architecture. SYNTHESIS feeds full record sets into the planner's context and answers follow-ups in-head; BYPASS, the deployed system, keeps records in session state, translates follow-ups into arguments for a deterministic filter, and delivers rows over a typed side channel. Across 24 dialogues (339 scored turns per condition), BYPASS scores 92.3% of turns fully correct, SYNTHESIS 45.7% (paired gap +46.6pp [+35.7, +57.1]). translated_title: 保真度随表格规模而非轮次数崩溃：部署型工具使用智能体中的交付架构
translated_abstract: 当多轮智能体将工具生成的结构化记录送入模型上下文并在每一轮重新输出时，每一轮都可能损坏工具原本正确计算的数据。我们在一个生产级奖励机票预订智能体中对此进行了测量：两种架构使用相同的冻结载荷、血统匹配的提示词与采样，仅在交付架构上存在差异。SYNTHESIS 架构将完整记录集送入规划器的上下文，并在模型内部直接回答后续问题；BYPASS 架构（即部署系统）则将记录保留在会话状态中，将后续问题转化为确定性过滤器的参数，并通过类型化旁路通道交付数据行。在 24 组对话（每种条件各 339 个评分轮次）中，BYPASS 有 92.3% 的轮次完全正确，而 SYNTHESIS 仅为 45.7%（配对差距 +46.6 个百分点 [+35.7, +57.1]）。通过按捕获日期改变交付表格的规模，SYNTHESIS 从 10 行及以下时的接近完美水平，崩溃至超过约 74 行时的 8% 或更低。在一个内容受控的前缀阶梯实验中……
tldr: 在生产级工具使用智能体中，回答正确性的崩溃取决于交付给模型的表格规模而非对话轮次数：将记录保留在会话状态并通过确定性过滤器与类型化旁路通道交付的 BYPASS 架构（92.3% 正确）显著优于将全部记录注入上下文的 SYNTHESIS 架构（45.7% 正确）。
en_tdlr: In a deployed tool-using agent, answer fidelity collapses with delivered table size rather than turn count: the BYPASS architecture, which keeps records in session state and delivers rows via a deterministic filter and typed side channel, achieves 92.3% fully correct turns versus 45.7% for the SYNTHESIS architecture that feeds full record sets into the model's context.
